build_pointnet2_cuda_extension: build the pointnet2 CUDA extension module by running python setup.py install in the project directory
install_pointnet2_package: install the pointnet2 package with compiled C++ and CUDA sources using pip install in the directory
review_setup_py_config: review the setup.py configuration for the pointnet2 CUDAExtension build arguments and include paths
summarize_cuda_extension_sources: summarize the pointnet2 setup.py to list all C++ and CUDA source files compiled into the extension
refactor_compile_args: refactor the setup.py extra compile arguments to add or remove optimization flags for cxx and nvcc
